info.title: School Management System API
info.description: Integrated API for the School Management System

get.description: Retrieves a list of all parents with basic information from the users table.

post.description: Creates a new parent profile and links it to an existing user account.

get.description: Retrieves full details for a parent based on their parent ID.

delete.description:
Deletes the parent record. This does not delete the user account.
Deletion is prevented if students are still linked to this parent.

get.description: Retrieves parent profile based on User ID. Useful for identifying the parent_id after login.
Retrieves the list of students associated with this parent.
